svg.title: Club Y design language
svg.desc: Type: Saans Regular and Medium at 15, 17 and 22 pixels. Colour: black, grey 666666, white and lilac d5afff. Space: an 8 pixel grid, steps 8 to 40. Marks: the Y mark, the wordmark, the lilac cursor and the Workshop Lab credit. Light: two soft lilac discs in the bottom right corner with a falloff of one minus r squared, squared. Motion: a 0.9 second rise, a city every 2.6 seconds, a slow drift, all off under reduce motion.
